prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: alternate wide GitHub README banner for devsweep, an open-source macOS developer disk cleanup terminal tool. Landscape approximately 2.4:1.
Primary request: an organized developer workbench that expresses deliberate selection of unused developer resources and protection of active work. Original refined editorial identity, instantly legible and specific to developers.
Composition: top-down view of ONE beautifully designed modular charcoal organizer tray on warm ivory paper. Tray dominates right two-thirds. Left third carries large clear lowercase word "devsweep", charcoal, precise mature technical typography, and a small mustard terminal prompt symbol. Generous clean margin around wordmark. No other text anywhere.
Inside the tray: precise fitted compartments containing recognizable miniature file-folder shapes, stacked package cubes with simple cube line marks, two phone simulator silhouettes, and a tile with a branching git-worktree diagram. Present the objects as tidy purposeful developer tools, not rubble. One recessed compartment is visibly protected: a dark terminal tile with prompt symbol and green active dot, plus a small engraved padlock on its compartment edge. Other compartments are neutral. At the far right, a mustard-yellow removable sorting tray has been partially slid out from the main tray and holds only a few obsolete folder and package pieces. Its vacated fitted recess exposes clear ivory negative space: reclaiming room by choosing what leaves. It should look like an elegant inventory of a developer's working environment.
Style: sophisticated technical editorial illustration, overhead industrial design drawing with gently dimensional solid forms, matte surfaces, precise clear geometry, subtle printed grain and restrained soft shadows. A coherent physical object, crafted like a tool organizer. NOT glossy 3D software marketing, NOT a fake software dashboard, NOT a photograph of an actual product.
Palette: warm ivory background, charcoal main tray and objects, mustard yellow removable tray and selection accent, tiny green dot for active terminal. Strong tonal separation so objects remain understandable when reduced to README width.
Text (verbatim): "devsweep". Only this word appears, spelled d e v s w e e p.
Constraints: no broom, no mascot, no robots, no brains, no trash can, no wreckage, no scattered decorative objects outside the organizer, no badges, no percentages or disk-space claims, no borrowed brand logos, no Apple logo, no fabricated app UI, no watermark, no gradients or neon glow. Avoid plastic toy aesthetic. Protected active compartment stays in place; only expendable selected pieces leave. Precise compartments and an unmistakably partially withdrawn yellow sorting drawer carry the story.
